fields.description: Domain vertical this preset belongs to (repair_shop, restaurant, …). Layout is independent of domain.
fields.label: Vertical

fields.description: Force the stacked single-panel layout + bottom dock at any viewport width.
fields.label: Lean Vertical Layout

fields.description: Registry key for the whole items panel.
fields.label: Items Panel

fields.description: Default list style inside the standard items panel (operator may still toggle).
fields.label: Items View Default

fields.description: Registry key for the cart view.
fields.label: Cart Style

fields.description: Comma-separated bottom-dock tab ids, in render order. Valid: browse, offers, cart, coupons, pay, floor, serviceOrder.
fields.label: Dock Tabs

fields.description: How an open ticket is backed. Blank keeps the shipped retail behaviour. Sales Invoice / POS Invoice submit the accounting document at pay (the cafeteria-counter default). Record Only backs the ticket with a POS Table Order and materialises the invoice only at settle — the mode full table service needs, because a draft invoice is force-deleted when its shift closes.
fields.label: Invoice Mode
fields.options:
Sales Invoice
POS Invoice
Record Only

fields.label: Keymap
fields.description: Keyboard layout pack this mode teaches (roadmap §17.3). Blank = muelle-default, the bindings POSAwesome has always shipped. A pack moves KEYS only — never what an action does — so a cashier migrating from another POS can keep their muscle memory. A register may override this via POS Profile → Keymap.
Comma-separated capability flags components check via verticalStore.has(). e.g. serial_imei, saldo, offers, coupons.
fields.label: Capabilities

fields.description: JSON map of label overrides resolved by verticalStore.t(key). e.g. {"Customer": "Mesa", "Order": "Comanda"}. Frappe translations are per-app, not per-tenant, so vocabulary lives here.
fields.label: Label Overrides (JSON)

fields.description: Default print format for sales from this vertical (repair ticket, kitchen ticket, …). Carried in the capability contract; the print path reads it when set.
fields.label: Default Print Format
